svg.title: keyframes: one file people set, and everyone works from
svg.desc: People write and refine keyframes.md, whose sections are Intent, Principles, Map, Constraints, Scenarios, Decisions, Taste, Questions, and Ideas. A constraint such as C3 (one-writer) carries a held-by pointer to the test that holds it. Agents read the file and cite the items they used. keyframes check proves every citation names an item and every held-by file exists, and a renamed test fails it as a broken pointer with exit 1. Findings go back to a person, who decides whether the plan, the code, or the check is wrong. A pointer resolves; it is never enforced. On the line, keyframes is the second hop: a plan file becomes a checked plan.
